name: Trollishly Social Media Profile Assistant
author: trollishly

sections.description:
Trollishly Social Media Profile Assistant allows WordPress site owners to display a clean and modern Follow bar directly under the post header on single post pages.

Site administrators can enter their TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube profile URLs from the plugin settings page. The plugin automatically displays clickable icons for each profile that open in a new tab so readers can easily follow your brand or creator accounts.

Key features:

  • TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube profile link support
  • Simple settings screen under Settings → Trollishly Social Media Profiles
  • Modern and lightweight Follow bar design
  • Works automatically on all single post pages
  • No JavaScript required
  • No external API calls
  • GDPR friendly since no tracking or external requests are made

This plugin is useful for creators, influencers, brands, and publishers who want to promote their social media profiles without adding heavy scripts or complicated integrations.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload the folder trollishly-social-media-profile-assistant into /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. In the WordPress admin area go to Plugins → Installed Plugins and activate Trollishly Social Media Profile Assistant.
  4. Navigate to Settings → Trollishly Social Media Profiles.
  5. Enter your TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube profile URLs and save the settings.
  6. Visit any single post to see the Follow bar rendered above the post content.
sections.faq:
Where does the Follow bar appear?

The Follow bar appears directly above the post content on all single post pages. This is usually right under the post header area. If needed you can move or customize its position by editing the plugin or using theme specific hooks.

Can I disable one of the icons?

Yes. If any profile field in the settings screen is left empty that platform icon will not be displayed on the frontend. For example if you only set a TikTok URL only the TikTok icon will appear.

Does this plugin require an API key?

No. All profile links are plain HTML anchors that point to your public social media URLs. The plugin does not call any external APIs and does not send any data to third party services.

Does this work with custom post types?

By default the Follow bar is only added to the standard post post type. If you want it to appear on custom post types as well you can modify the condition in the frontend filter or extend the plugin with your own hook to target additional post types.

Are the icons SVG or text?

The plugin uses simple text based buttons styled with CSS. You can replace them with SVG icons or icon fonts by editing the markup in the frontend file and adjusting the CSS in the plugin style sheet or your theme.

Will this slow down my site?

The plugin only adds a small block of HTML and a lightweight CSS file. There are no external scripts or remote requests so the impact on performance is minimal.
